blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الدهن للجمعة رقم:٨٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Salman Farsi (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If a person bathes on the day of Jumu'ah, maintains cleanliness as much as he can, applies the oil he has or puts on the perfume that is in his house, then goes to the masjid and does not sit between two people sitting together, prays the Salahs before Jumu'ah as much as the opportunity allows him, and when the imam delivers the khutbah sermon, listens silently and attentively, then his sins committed from that Jumu'ah back to the previous Jumu'ah are forgiven.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ فِي جُمُعَةٍ مِنَ الْجُمَعِ: مَعَاشِرَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ! إِنَّ هذَا يَوْمٌ جَعَلَهُ اللهُ لَكُمْ عِيدًا فَاغْتَسِلُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ بِالسِّوَاكِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الاوسط والصغير ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٣٨٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, “Once, on the day of Jumu'ah, Rasulullah ﷺ said, ”O Muslims! Allah has made this day an Eid (festival) for you, so bathe on this day, and make it a point to clean your teeth with the miswak.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ الْغُسْلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ لَيَسُلُّ الْخَطَايَا مِنْ أُصُولِ الشَّعْرِ اِسْتِلَالاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله ثقات مجمع الزوائد:٢ /٣٩١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Umamah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Bathing on the day of Jumu'ah pulls the sins out completely from the roots of the hair.”
